condition: Only after separate authority selects a finite numeric H and authorizes the precise correction; H is unselected in these plans.
analystDecision: C1 is conditionally the smallest coherent scope; no numeric H selected by this audit and no automatic aggregate/CLI increase.

occupancy.perHelper: min(H,20000-used,D-S) admission/success ceiling; not a hard real-time OS termination guarantee
occupancy.aggregate: 20000 ms active success/admission ceiling remains shared across all serial helpers, rather than9×H. A failed active helper is terminal and cannot restart its allowance.
occupancy.cli: 30000 ms bounds original invocation/admission; pre-submission failed disposition has existing2000 allowance. It is not a universal process-lifetime ceiling after a non-cancellable rename was timely admitted.
occupancy.processRoles: one supervisor + at most one helper + possible attributable console; one evaluation worker thread without overlap
occupancy.singleHelperIncrement: For a non-clipped call, at most H−5000 ms additional permitted active interval; actual allowed increment may be smaller because aggregate/CLI remaining budgets win.
occupancy.cleanup: 2000 remains anchored to original terminal event, never success time. A larger H delays when failure/cleanup can begin but does not justify a longer cleanup allowance.
occupancy.crossInvocation: Independent public API calls are the embedding host responsibility. No new global queue/concurrency/OS sandbox guarantee is created.

attackerAssessment: Explicit operator-pinned files are still untrusted content: count, bytes, deep bounded paths and filesystem layout can influence work even when integrity/authority eventually reject. Acquisition occurs before every semantic fact is trusted.

No unbounded enumeration: explicit128-path allowlist, cap+1 reads, bounded frame/base64/JSON limits and maximum full-path length remain. Increasing H cannot compensate for an unbounded admitted class.

Native regular-file/type/reparse/hardlink/volume/final-path checks and held/fresh identity observations stay intact. Private immutable roots remain an operator precondition, not protection from a privileged concurrent OS attacker.
Slow permitted local filesystem access, CPU contention and PowerShell startup can consume the finite lifecycle. No fixed Windows scheduling or syscall completion guarantee is inferred.

Larger occupancy increases how long an authorized invocation can retain process/memory/handles and delay refusal. Aggregate/CLI clipping limits this exposure; it does not promise successful work at every maximum input shape.
The512MiB aggregate RSS figure is an externally observed engineering acceptance ceiling. Worker heaps are configured, but no hard whole-process memory sandbox is created.
No network, credential, arbitrary script/executable, persistent helper/service, retry or background work authority is added.

candidates.reason: Preserves independent cumulative/overall caps. min-formula is internally coherent even if not every helper can spend H; admission caps are not per-slot reservations or a guarantee9maxima will succeed.
Increasing aggregate would enlarge cumulative native exposure; requires measured independent aggregate insufficiency and explicit new security rationale, not9×H.
Longer CLI admission enlarges prepublication occupancy and staging/admission opportunity; no automatic need follows from a larger per-helper ceiling.
Broadens multiple independent controls without direct dependency; API/worker/cleanup have no justified increase.
